snippet.title: Gameplay Agent of Veil
snippet.description:
Can you pass a spy agency's interview? 
Puzzle your way into the covert world of espionage as a potential recruit for an elusive spy agency in Agent of Veil, a puzzle adventure. Pass an unconventional spy interview, solve puzzles, answer quirky questions and uncover the agency's secrets.
